basic_info.description: Incredible value at The Beacon, offering a rare combination of quiet, comfort, and convenience in one of SF's most vibrant and well-connected neighborhoods, Mission Bay. This sun-filled 1BD/1BA residence features an efficient, open-concept layout with expansive windows overlooking a tranquil, tree-lined interior garden. The contemporary kitchen is appointed with granite countertops, stainless steel appliances, and ample storage, while a well-proportioned bedroom, rich wood floors, and in-unit laundry provide everyday comfort and ease. Designed for those seeking a peaceful retreat without sacrificing city access, the home is set within a premier full-service building offering resort-style amenities: 24/7 lobby attendant, heated outdoor pool, two spas, sauna, state-of-the-art fitness center, clubhouse w full kitchen, business lounge & private dog park. Perfectly situated above Safeway and Starbucks & steps from Oracle Park, Ferry Building farmers market, Embarcadero waterfront, UCSF, and an array of acclaimed restaurants & cafes. With 94 Walk Score, effortless access to Caltrain, MUNI, and BART, plus quick connections to I-280/101, this serene yet connected residence offers low-maintenance living paired with the energy and convenience of the city at your doorstep.
